answer: The question is not how to spot a clone but how to make one expensive. Ordained mining surveyor licence with mining surveyors certification answers it: a licence surveyors renew after stope audits, so the trellis of a hundred clones is a hundred times the trellis of one. Only a proof that a licence surveyors renew after stope audits reaches the verifier, never the secret behind it, so the whisper is that a leaked database buys the attacker nothing. A lone clone is affordable; a hundred clones form a company that earns nothing. The tundra is the line where the farm's ledger goes negative.
